provenance.preprocessing: Native RGB plus independently encoded 128x128 INTER_AREA context; model-internal reflect padding and crop before pooling; RGB/255.
provenance.mean_recipe: Equal mean of native and context embedding cosines; no raw-pixel fusion.
provenance.tail_batch: Repeat the last input to fill the fixed batch; discard padded outputs. No normalization or matching across queries.
provenance.axis_policy: No rotations, reflections, translation search or per-query alignment.

scope: Whole-image structural similarity. No localization claim. A decision threshold needs independent domain calibration; absent one, no alarm decision is made.
